sourceOfTruth: Rules source records are referenced by stable IDs; legacy structured data remains read-only during migration.

policies.translations: Only localization fields are translated; rules and mechanics have one language-independent canonical representation.
policies.provenance: Each source record must retain book and page.
policies.homebrew: Never merge DM homebrew modifiers into official item definitions.
policies.derived: Computed fields belong to engine output, not the canonical character JSON.
